display_name: Test: Author notes are not live
description: Test of step 2b: a "_"-prefixed author note (an NPC's _creds_old, an object's _draft, a note in container contents, a command board's _note, a dead grant_foothold under _draft) never ships to the browser, while a room whose id starts with "_" (_annex), a "_" global name and free data (object-valued globals, minigameData) ship as authored. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove the client payload strips every author note while free data and "_" ids ship, through the real bootstrap, room and container routes
